summary: In this story, a household helper robot keeps making small mistakes while trying to be useful, until his family patiently teaches him, and he finally helps in just the right way during a busy morning.
introduce: Ask students to share a small problem they solved this week and how they solved it, and write two examples in a Problem | Solution chart on the board. Tell them that “The Robot Who Learned to Help” also has a problem and a solution to find.

keyTerms.def: able to stay calm and wait without getting annoyed, even when something is slow or difficult
very wet, as if completely filled with water
the way a machine is adjusted to work in a certain way

challengeTerms.def: feeling unable to cope because there is too much happening at once
to adjust a machine or tool carefully so it works correctly

discussion: Do you agree or disagree that a robot that keeps making mistakes should be sent back instead of given more chances? Use evidence from the story to explain.
Explain how patient teaching from Mom and Dad helped Robi go from making mistakes to helping in just the right way.
struggling: Read the first part of the story aloud together, review patient, soaked, and setting, and let weak readers fill in a simple Problem | Solution chart with sentence starters.
gifted: Challenge advanced readers to use overwhelmed, calibrate, and gratitude in a short paragraph that suggests a second solution to the problem and judge which works better.
